lessons_used: Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted actual impact, while negative or zero forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-15.9% and -9.0%).
Choose path copy updates (choose_path, copy) hurt performance across 2 agreeing tests (-3.0% and -3.7%), despite 1 winning test (+3.7%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 8 of 10 tests, despite 2 winning tests (+3.6% and +6.5%).
Adoption redesigns (adoption, redesign) and sign-in hints (sign_in, hint) produced highly inconsistent results, ranging from strong wins to severe losses.

candidates.title: Pick Friend Card Grid Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the pet selection interface into an interactive card grid featuring companion choice cards.
candidates.why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8%; structured card selection makes comparing starter companions faster and clearer.

guard.reason: replacement for 'pick_friend.pet_choices' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['choice_cards'] with real words

candidates.title: Pet Voice Tone Selector Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Add an interactive sound component to the companion selection screen allowing users to preview pet vocal tones.
candidates.why: Support receives confusion emails about how to talk to or hear pets after onboarding; early sound interaction sets communication expectations.

guard.reason: Adds a sound preview component to companion selection screen within onboarding limits.

candidates.score_note: New sub-flows in adoption step historically underperform (-7.1%).

candidates.title: Custom Pet Inspection Screen
candidates.change: Insert a new pet inspection screen immediately after photo upload for users to review their custom pet render before adoption.
candidates.why: Users submitted 3 support tickets about custom pets failing or looking wrong; previewing reduces post-adoption rendering surprises.

new_pet_preview.headline: Inspect Your Custom Companion
new_pet_preview.body: Confirm your desktop pet appearance before finalizing adoption.

guard.reason: Inserts a valid preview screen within onboarding without removing any required steps or functionality.

candidates.score_note: Adding extra screens consistently hurts funnel conversion.

candidates.title: Home Intro Grid Stage Redesign
candidates.change: Redesign the home welcome screen into a grid layout with a control checklist component.
candidates.why: Finish stage drops to 75.5% conversion and users report confusion about controlling or hiding pets on desktop.

guard.reason: replacement for 'home_intro.home_welcome' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'text'] with real words

candidates.title: Sign In Existing Pet Account Hint
candidates.change: Add an explicit hint explaining that signing in with an existing account restores lost pets and saved desktop data.
candidates.why: The single largest support theme (8 emails) concerns pets missing or reset after signing in with a secondary account.

sign_in.hint: Signing in with your original account automatically restores your existing desktop pets and progress.

guard.reason: Adds informative account restoration hint on sign in screen without violating pricing or dark pattern rules.

candidates.score_note: Solves largest support complaint via simple text config.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Desktop Slot Visual
candidates.change: Add an animated desktop slot indicator component to the waiting screen while background pet files prepare.
candidates.why: Waiting step median duration is 201s and 3 users reported pets failing to appear on the desktop upon app launch.

guard.reason: Adds desktop slot allocation animation to waiting screen, keeping pet generation status clear.

candidates.score_note: Wait info updates yield minor positive average historical lift (+1.8%).

candidates.title: Story Screen Two Column Layout
candidates.change: Redesign the story onboarding screen to a two-column layout paired with a companion mascot asset.
candidates.why: Choose path has an extremely high mean completion time of 514s, showing users get stuck during initial intro narrative.

guard.reason: replacement for 'story.intro_story' does not do the job: needs 1 of ['animation', 'image', 'mascot', 'video'] with an asset:story/ asset

candidates.title: Move Sign In Before Desktop Generation
candidates.change: Move account sign-in after pet adoption certification, right before desktop pet generation begins.
candidates.why: Adoption drop-off is 78.8%; allowing users to select and customize their companion first increases investment before asking for sign-in.

guard.reason: Reorders sign-in step after adoption certificate as explicitly permitted by onboarding reordering rules.

candidates.score_note: Delays friction of sign-in, targeting high adoption drop-off.

candidates.title: Waiting Screen Launch Opt-In Notification
candidates.change: Enable ready notification opt-in prompt with explicit ready notification toggle on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Home wait stage has a mean time of 2336s; notifying users when processing finishes lets them safely background the app.

guard.reason: Adds notification opt-in button on waiting screen without false urgency or dark patterns.

candidates.score_note: Helps users handle long wait times (2336s mean duration).

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Stage Layout
candidates.change: Switch adoption certificate layout to stage format featuring an official pet companion badge.
candidates.why: Reinforces companion ownership right before the generation wait step to reduce exit rate prior to final desktop launch.

guard.reason: Redesigns adoption certificate layout and includes companion badge serving as official certification.

candidates.score_note: Layout tweak targets high adoption drop step (21.2% drop) safely.

picked: Move Sign In Before Desktop Generation

decisions.title: Move Sign In Before Desktop Generation
